title: auklet-se-config-daypad
content:
Quick notes for Auklet Health private deployment - working scratchpad

Context / goal:
- Get Auklet Health running Redwood Private in their GCP VPC with customer-managed KMS and an initial dedicated GPU pool.
- Deliver a canary rollout of model v1.3 -> v1.4 with rollback hooks, and a fallback to smaller quantized variant for burst protection.
- Timeline: PoC infra ready by end of week (Mar 13), canary deploy next week.

Immediate action items (priority ordering)
[ ] 1) VPC peering & routes: confirm subnets and CIDR ranges, add static routes for private control plane. (Owner: Maya) - target 2026-03-12
    - Auklet VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (confirm)
    - Redwood control plane endpoints: 10.10.240.0/22 (ask infra if changed)
    - Firewall rules: allow TCP 443, 22 from control plane, allow inter-node gRPC ports 50051-50060

[ ] 2) KMS setup: generate key in Auklet GCP project, grant service account redwood-private-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com CryptoKey Encrypter/Decrypter
    - Key name convention: projects/auklet-project/locations/global/keyRings/redwood-keys/cryptoKeys/rdw-key-auklet
    - Testing command (gcloud): gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring redwood-keys --key rdw-key-auklet --plaintext-file=tokentest.txt --ciphertext-file=cipher.txt

[ ] 3) Dedicated GPU pool sizing: recommend 4xA100-40GB for initial PoC (throughput target ~800 tokens/s across 4 concurrent streams)
    - Alternate cheaper: 6xA10 or 8xT4s for cost testing; plan quantized path for T4s
    - Ask capacity team: is continuous batching supported on mixed GPU pool? (Samir)

[ ] 4) Network egress and registry access: Ensure nodes can pull docker images from registry.redwood.internal (if private) or gcr.io/redwood-inference.
    - If air-gapped, we need pre-pulled tarballs + image signature validation step.

Configuration snippets / env vars (copy these when creating manifests)
- REDWOOD_PRIVATE_MODE=true
- REDWOOD_CONTROL_PLANE_URL=https://control.private.redwood.internal:443
- REDWOOD_KMS_PROVIDER=gcp
- REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=projects/auklet-project/locations/global/keyRings/redwood-keys/cryptoKeys/rdw-key-auklet
- REDWOOD_CLUSTER_GPU_PROFILE=A100-40GB
- REDWOOD_AUTOSCALE_MIN=2
- REDWOOD_AUTOSCALE_MAX=8

Docker images relevant:
- redwood/private-runtime:release-2026-02-18 (use this for PoC)
- redwood/quant-runtime:qc-1.2 (for int8 pathway check)

Canary rollout plan (high level)
- Stage 0: Deploy control plane + infra, smoke test connectivity and KMS decrypt
- Stage 1: Deploy runtime pool with model v1.3 (baseline), 2 nodes, run perf suite for 24h
- Stage 2: Canary v1.4 to 10% traffic via routing policy, run quality evals (prompt-set aub-001), monitor latency & errors for 2h
- Stage 3: If error rate > 1% or p95 latency increases > 30% -> automatic rollback to v1.3 and alert on pager
- Stage 4: If stable, ramp to 50% and then full within 24h

Fallbacks and graceful degradation
- Map fallback policy: model v1.4 -> fallback qv1.4-int8 -> v1.3. Policy TTL 2m for node readiness
- Region fallback: if GCP us-west1 capacity constraint, route to us-central1 dedicated pool (customer approved?) - check with Auklet on cross-region data policy

Open questions / unknowns (need answers before PoC)
- Data residency: Do they allow cross-region inference? Auklet security says no PII leaves us-west1 unless encrypted at rest and in transit. Need legal sign-off for fallback region.
- Logging retention: Auklet wants logs at 12 months. Do we have budget for log egress and storage? (Finance)
- Can customer provide a test corpus of 500 prompts for quality evals? Prefer realistic prompts to measure hallucination/regression.

Debug / troubleshooting shortcuts
- Check node status: ./rdwctl node list --cluster auklet-poc
- KMS test decrypt from node: kubectl exec -it runtime-pod -- rdw-kms-cli decrypt --key $REDWOOD_KMS_KEY --ciphertext /tmp/cipher.txt
- View recent token cost: /opt/redwood/bin/token-cost --window 1h --model v1.3
- Increase debug logs: set REDWOOD_RUNTIME_LOG=debug then tail /var/log/redwood/runtime.log

Meeting notes 2026-03-11 sync with Auklet SE (Ruth)
- They will provide KMS key by EOD 3/12 but need detailed IAM policy sample. I sent sample policy (attached link in Confluence).
- Confirmed they can accept cross-region fallback if data is end-to-end encrypted and keys remain in us-west1. Legal to confirm.
- They asked for cost projection comparing A100 vs A10 setups. Need to run quick perf/cost sim. (Samir to run)

Personal TODOs (short term)
- [ ] Draft IAM JSON for KMS access and upload to Confluence (Maya) - due 3/12
- [ ] Wire up initial infra templates (terraform snippets) for VPC peering and firewall (Maya + Infra) - due 3/13
- [ ] Run perf sim on quantized runtime using 1k prompts (Samir) - due 3/14
- [ ] Prepare 10-min demo for Auklet execs showing canary rollback (Maya) - due 3/16

Notes to self / quick reminders
- Keep canary window short for customer comfort; emphasize automatic rollback.
- If they push for lower cost, show quantization tradeoffs with sample outputs to set expectations.
- Remember to include cost estimate for 12-month log retention in the proposal - customers always forget this line item.

Scratch area (commands / snippets to copy)
- terraform import google_compute_network.poc_network projects/auklet-project/global/networks/rdw-poc-net
- rdwctl deploy --profile private --cluster auklet-poc --image redwood/private-runtime:release-2026-02-18 --gpu A100-40GB --nodes 2
- kubectl apply -f rdw-canary-route.yaml (ensure route trafficPercent: 10)

End of day quick status (03/12)
- VPC CIDR confirmed but firewall rule needs explicit gRPC port allow (in progress)
- KMS key created by Auklet but IAM binding pending (waiting on service account email)
- Terraform templates at ~70% (need subnet and peering block)

-- Maya
